items.title: The Pulse: We need to talk about migrations with AI
items.summary: Asana completed a testing framework migration in two weeks, that they would have delayed for years more, and they’re not alone. Also: AI startups could make Gartner much less relevant, and more

items.title: From Chrome DevTools to AI Engineering, with Addy Osmani
items.summary: Addy Osmani shares lessons from 14 years at Google and how AI agents are reshaping software engineering, developer workflows, and the skills engineers need to succeed.

items.title: Headed for the Exit: the Great Engineering Leader Career Break
items.summary: Trend: more CTOs, VPEs, and Heads of Engineering are walking away from their high-status, in-demand positions. There are many reasons, mostly related to AI, and to "founder mode"
